**BLUF:** No major law enforcement incidents, fires, or hazards reported in Tazewell County or immediate core area (Bluefield VA/WV, Mercer County WV, neighboring counties) in the last 24 hours. Community events and local government actions dominate in Bluefield and Princeton, including shopping promotions and safety drives. In the broader region, West Virginia state-level developments include a federal indictment of the state auditor and Supreme Court rulings on education and judicial matters.[[1]](https://www.herald-dispatch.com/_recent_news/)[[2]](https://www.wvnews.com/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours in the core or immediate neighboring counties.

In the region: A federal grand jury indicted West Virginia State Auditor Mark Hunt and others on charges related to an alleged property stealing scheme (statewide WV impact).[[1]](https://www.herald-dispatch.com/_recent_news/)[[2]](https://www.wvnews.com/)

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours in the core or region.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours. No active NWS alerts. Weather is stable with warm and dry conditions expected.[[3]](https://www.wvnstv.com/video/warm-dry-this-week/12378059/)

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Core:** The City of Bluefield (WV) encourages residents to shop locally on November 20 as part of nationwide Pink Friday. The city also asks residents not to pour hazardous chemicals on garbage bags to deter bears and protect sanitation workers. Princeton (Mercer County, WV) is holding a “Tie One On for Safety” event to encourage sober driving this holiday season. Former Mercer County school sites are now available for sale online.[[4]](https://www.zillow.com/tazewell-county-va/newest/)

Southern West Virginia Community and Technical College (SVCC, Logan area) inaugurated its fourth president.[[4]](https://www.zillow.com/tazewell-county-va/newest/)

**Region:** The West Virginia Supreme Court upheld the admonishment of a judge who spoke publicly about CPS understaffing and overturned a 2025 law that gave the Legislature more power over the state Board of Education.[[4]](https://www.zillow.com/tazewell-county-va/newest/)

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core:** The Bluefield Rotary announced a community rally to support local service. The Bluefield alumnae chapter of Delta Sigma Theta collected more than 850 food items for a Thanksgiving drive.[[4]](https://www.zillow.com/tazewell-county-va/newest/)

Grundy Wrestling Club (Buchanan County, VA) returned to the mats after a fire destroyed their previous gym.[[4]](https://www.zillow.com/tazewell-county-va/newest/)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours.

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- November 20: Pink Friday local shopping promotion in Bluefield.
- Ongoing: Princeton sober driving safety event.
- Statewide WV: Continued coverage of auditor indictment and related calls for action.[[2]](https://www.wvnews.com/)
- No scheduled major court dates or weather hazards noted in core sources.
